topic: Porting a Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @cloudflare/sandbox@next (Sandbox SDK 1.0 preview) - API deltas, migration steps, pitfalls

subtopics.scope: When to use the migration skill vs sibling skills (sandbox-stable for day-to-day stable work, sandbox-next for new @next apps), the 2026 deprecation guide as optional prerequisite, the 'migrate when you can, do not force production cutover' stance, and the human guide links (Migrate page, 1.0 preview page).

subtopics.scope: The migration's hard invariants: Worker package and container image on the same @next line, immediate container rollout because control protocols are incompatible both ways, await sandbox.exec means process started not finished, argv as-is with no implicit shell, process handles have no stdin, timeout/AbortSignal cancels the wait only, no single retry loop for every error, self-deployed bridge stays on stable.

subtopics.scope: Row-by-row stable to @next API deltas from the replacement map: transport removal (RPC only), buffered exec becomes handle plus output/waits, execStream/startProcess unified into one process handle with logs/waitFor/kill, sessions removed in favor of per-launch cwd/env, terminal API change (createTerminal, terminal.connect, terminalId), interpreter moved to withInterpreter, gitCheckout replaced by argv git via exec, string kill signals now numeric only, and the mostly-unchanged areas (files, mounts, backups, ports, tunnels, proxyToSandbox).
